chunks: Al-Naḍr narrated from Shuʿayb al-ʿAqarqūfī, who said:

I and Ḥadīd set out until we reached the orchard on the Day of Tarwiyah. I went ahead on a donkey, arrived in Makkah, performed tawaf and saʿy, exited from my tamattuʿ, then entered ihram for hajj. Ḥadīd arrived during the night, so I wrote to Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, seeking his ruling regarding his case.
So he wrote to me: “Tell him to perform tawaf and saʿy, exit from his mutʿah, enter ihram for hajj, join the people at Minā, and he must not spend the night in Makkah.”

key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Minā, where pilgrims proceed for the hajj rites
key_terms.تَمَتُّعِي: my tamattuʿ, the ʿumrah portion of hajj al-tamattuʿ
key_terms.سَعَيْتُ: I performed saʿy between Ṣafā and Marwah
key_terms.طُفْتُ: I performed tawaf around the Kaʿbah
key_terms.لَا يَبِيتَنَّ بِمَكَّةَ: he must not remain overnight in Makkah
key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلتَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah, the 8th of Dhū al-Ḥijjah before the main hajj rites

ai.seo_question: If a person performing tamattuʿ reaches Makkah late on the Day of Tarwiyah, what should they do?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one performing tamattuʿ who arrives late on the Day of Tarwiyah. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that he should still perform tawaf and saʿy, exit from tamattuʿ, enter ihram for hajj, and proceed to Minā without remaining overnight in Makkah.
